note: City of Holton campground at Prairie Lake (about 43 acres in an 80-acre park), 2 miles east and 2 miles north of town; the lake is Holton's water supply. Sites with and without electricity, first come on a nightly city permit; designated swimming area, playground, boat ramp and docks, no-wake boating. Park hours 6 a.m.-11 p.m.; no alcohol, fires in the rings only. --Claude
summary: City of Holton page (headless read 2026-11-06): $10/night with electricity, $8 without; 'Campsites may not be reserved'; 14 days then 24 h off; open March through October. Booking (fcfs always, max 14) and season (03-01..10-31) added; fees re-sourced. 55 sites / 26 full hookup not on the city page (left, flagged). Pin is in the lake: move ~105 m W onto the northwest loop. Waterfront lead: lakeview.
flags: PIN IN THE LAKE: stored 39.48950,-95.68850 is on open water ~40 m off the northwest loop's dock (NAIP and Esri both). Propose 39.4900,-95.6900, the gravel loop on the west shore just north of the cove (dock, small building, sites around the loop). A second developed area on the southwest point (~39.4877,-95.6907) holds shelters, a ball field and the beach - reads as day use. Google's 'Prairie Lake Campground' point (39.49174,-95.69204) is the park entrance on 246 Rd.

WATERFRONT LEAD: stored 'not waterfront'. The northwest loop's road runs along the shore 5-15 m from the water on open grass, with sites inside the loop - the loop road sits between them and the lake, so lakeview, not lakefront. Propose 'lakeview'. Lake ~43 acres (city page).

SITES / HOOKUPS UNSOURCED: '55 shaded sites, 26 full hookup and the rest electric' (inclusion evidence, note) is not on the city page, which only distinguishes sites with and without electricity. Stored sites.count 55 and hookups water/sewer true (derived) are left untouched, but no current source backs them; imagery doesn't show 55 pads clearly. Worth a call to the city before trusting the full-hookup claim.
